svg.title: External services
svg.desc: Every outside service Fork depends on: what it costs, whose account it is and what it holds. 28 components and 26 flows.
svg.text: Every outside service Fork depends on: what it costs, whose account it is and what it holds

g.title: Fork Studio — Built — Producer app: projects, samples, signed versions, store, network and phone access.
Fork Music — Built — Fan app: store, library, passes, encrypted delivery and the shared player.
Fork Labels — Built — Label management app: releases, submissions, contracts and payouts.
Fork Manager — Built — Management app: gigs, invoices, press, riders, social and accounts.
Meta Graph API — Live — Posts videos and photos to Instagram and Facebook for the artist.
SoundCloud API — Live — Uploads and reads releases on the label's SoundCloud account.
Google (Gmail, YouTube) — Live — Sends label emails and publishes to YouTube with the artist's own Google account.
Tunnel providers — Live — Give Fork Manager a temporary public address so Instagram can fetch a video.
GitHub release feeds — Postponed — Delivers app installers and signed automatic updates to testers.
Apple Developer Program — Postponed — not zero-cost — Lets the apps open on other computers without the security warning (signing and notarisation).
Supabase — Live — The cloud heart: accounts, database, Edge Functions, secret vault and timers; the licence validator and the Store signer run here.
npm and crates.io — Live — Download the open-source building blocks when the apps are built.
forkgate.io site — Built — Landing, beta signup, protocol survey, verify and licence pages, admin and /download.
/connect PWA — Built — Installable phone web app: Studio tunnel, swarm reader and file upload.
Edge Functions — Built — Server-side functions: checkout, webhook, settle, certs, invites, verify and wallet.
Resend — Live — Sends all Supabase Auth emails (sign-up, magic link, reset) and beta invites from noreply@forkgate.io via smtp.resend.com:465.
Stripe — Planned — not zero-cost — Takes payments for licences and pays artists out; money is held back to cover disputes.
GitHub Pages — Live — Hosts forkgate.io: landing, beta signup, verify pages, /connect and this admin.
GitHub Actions — Planned — A scheduled job that touches Supabase so it never pauses from idleness.
forkgate.io domain — Live — not zero-cost — The public address of the site and of every link in the apps.
jsDelivr CDN — Live — Serves the Supabase browser library to the site, admin and /connect.
fork-signer — Built — Hot licence signer: Stripe queue, serials, Solana mint/transfer/freeze and key release; off by default.
P2P swarm — Building — Encrypted blocks on Fork computers and phones, three copies, direct transfers and release seeding.
Solana devnet — Live — Beta licence seals: every licence is recorded on a practice blockchain, free to test the real code.
Solana mainnet — Planned — not zero-cost — Real licence seals from alpha: the permanent public record that a licence exists.
Helius RPC — Planned — A reliable line into the blockchain that can also list a wallet's licences (DAS).
VPS relay — Not used — A small always-on server that would help two computers behind strict routers reach each other.
Public STUN servers — Live — Lets the phone and the computer find each other for the direct tunnel.
